create_table_sql:
CREATE TABLE public.ai_deployments (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    model_id uuid NOT NULL,
    deployment_name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    endpoint text,
    region character varying(100),
    priority integer DEFAULT 0,
    is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.ai_models (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    display_name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    model_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    context_window integer,
    max_output_tokens integer,
    supports_stream boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    supports_json boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    supports_vision boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    supports_tools boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.ai_profiles (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    storage_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    vector_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    embedding_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    is_default boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    extract_storage_provider_id uuid,
    chunk_storage_provider_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE public.ai_providers (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    provider_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    base_url text,
    api_version character varying(50),
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.ai_routing_policies (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    task_id uuid NOT NULL,
    name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    strategy character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.ai_routing_policy_items (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    routing_policy_id uuid NOT NULL,
    deployment_id uuid NOT NULL,
    priority integer NOT NULL,
    weight integer,
    is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.ai_tasks (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(200) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    is_enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.chunking_strategies (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

CREATE TABLE public.classification_engines (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

CREATE TABLE public.data_hub_providers (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    configuration_schema jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunk_batches (
    id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    batch_index integer NOT NULL,
    total_chunks integer NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    classification_completed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    embedding_completed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    batch_completed boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunk_classifications (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    chunk_id uuid NOT NULL,
    model_name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    label character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    confidence double precision,
    raw_response jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunk_embeddings (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    chunk_id uuid NOT NULL,
    model_name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    embedding public.vector NOT NULL,
    dimension integer NOT NULL,
    token_count integer,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_chunks (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    batch_id uuid NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    chunk_index integer NOT NULL,
    title text,
    content text NOT NULL,
    metadata jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_extractions (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    structured_content jsonb NOT NULL,
    page_count integer,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_images (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    page_number integer NOT NULL,
    asset_url text NOT NULL,
    description text,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_pipeline_states (
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    chunks jsonb,
    labels jsonb,
    embeddings jsonb,
    chunks_ready boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    classification_ready boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    embedding_ready boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    index_event_published boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);

CREATE TABLE public.document_processing_tasks (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    task_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    retry_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    error_message text,
    started_at timestamp with time zone,
    finished_at timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    batch_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE public.documents (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    source_id uuid NOT NULL,
    file_name character varying(500) NOT NULL,
    department character varying(255),
    owner_role character varying(255),
    security_level character varying(255),
    document_type character varying(255),
    source_file_url text,
    last_modified_at timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    file_extension character varying(20),
    file_size_bytes bigint,
    external_file_id text,
    provider_metadata jsonb,
    original_file_path text
);

CREATE TABLE public.embedding_models (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    dimension integer NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

CREATE TABLE public.enterprises (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::character varying,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.extraction_engines (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    provider character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true
);

CREATE TABLE public.features (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.ingest_jobs (
    id text NOT NULL,
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    error_message text,
    started_at timestamp with time zone,
    finished_at timestamp with time zone
);

CREATE TABLE public.ingestion_document_states (
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    ingestion_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.ingestion_job_configurations (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    ingestion_job_id uuid NOT NULL,
    is_classification boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    chunking_strategy_id uuid NOT NULL,
    extraction_engine_id uuid NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    model_set_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE public.ingestion_jobs (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    trigger_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    is_build_graph boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    total_files integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    completed_files integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    failed_files integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    started_at timestamp with time zone,
    finished_at timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    scope_type character varying(50),
    scope_data jsonb,
    knowledge_space_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE public.ingestion_sources (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    source_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    provider_type character varying(100),
    provider_configuration jsonb
);

CREATE TABLE public.knowledge_space_data_hubs (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    knowledge_space_id uuid NOT NULL,
    data_hub_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.knowledge_space_embedding_configs (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    knowledge_space_id uuid NOT NULL,
    embedding_model_id uuid NOT NULL,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.knowledge_spaces (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    status character varying(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::character varying,
    configuration jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    enterprise_id uuid
);

CREATE TABLE public.model_set_items (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    model_set_id uuid NOT NULL,
    ai_model_id uuid NOT NULL,
    priority integer NOT NULL,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.model_sets (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    feature_id uuid NOT NULL,
    code character varying(100) NOT NULL,
    name character varying(255) NOT NULL,
    description text,
    enabled boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.storage_assets (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    storage_provider_id uuid NOT NULL,
    asset_type character varying(50) NOT NULL,
    storage_path text NOT NULL,
    content_type character varying(255),
    size_bytes bigint,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.sync_states (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    source_id uuid NOT NULL,
    delta_token text,
    last_sync_at timestamp with time zone,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    updated_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE public.table_assets (
    id uuid NOT NULL DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
    document_id uuid NOT NULL,
    sheet_name text NOT NULL,
    description text,
    row_count bigint,
    schema_json jsonb NOT NULL,
    storage_path text NOT NULL,
    created_at timestamp with time zone NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
